name: Ghe
summary: Ghẹ is the swimmer crab visitors ask for at Hàng Dương, also served as ghẹ nấu bầu. Some shells are red-pink and some are green, and the meat is firmer in the last days of the lunar month.
origin: Can Gio. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014.
howToEat: At the market, point at a live crab and the stall cooks it, or take a pan already on the fire. In town, ghẹ nấu bầu is the named plate.

Thanh Niên prints one crab at 450,000 VND a kilogram on 11 Mar 2019, and a cook-to-order fee of 10,000 VND a kilogram for steaming and 30,000 for the other cooks. VnExpress, updated 28 Feb 2025, says the cook-to-order cost is a few tens of thousands of đồng. The 2019 fees and that 2025 line both stay. A 2026 board is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, or the town streets for ghẹ nấu bầu. The hour is Check on arrival.
